maria (release-lead): T-90m starting dry-run for the midnight EU change window. I’ll step through a quick checklist here — please ack and call out anything blocking.
ci-bot: [CI] Preflight: lint ✅ unit ✅ smoke ✅ for release/v3.4.2. All checks green.
alex (platform): ack — pre-warmed GPU pools in eu-1 are online (dash: https://dash.internal/pools/eu-1). Reserved capacity at expected levels.
chris (eng-sre): oncall ack. Confirm rollback playbook is pinned: /runbooks/rollbacks/release-v3.4.2. KV cache warmup scheduled + I'll watch eviction during canary.
taylor (qa): running synthetic traffic now, sending summary in ~10m. so far basic flows look OK.
sam (product): quick note — final release notes doc updated, added note about embeddings latency regression and the mitigation plan.
maria (release-lead): OK running pin command for change window now: `deploy-bot pin release/v3.4.2 --window=eu-midnight --owner=maria`

chris (eng-sre): infra quick check — baseline latency OK but 95p tail on /v1/embeddings up ~15% vs baseline in canary. Recommend reduce canary traffic to 5% and run extra smoke on long prompts.
maria (release-lead): acknowledged. Adjusting canary now: `deploy-bot adjust-canary --percent 5 --cluster=eu-1`

alex (platform): ops note: autoscaler burst cap set to 20% for window, memory margin at 12%. If mem > 80% on any replica, trigger emergency rollback.
sam (product): final go/no-go — any unresolved blocks?
chris (eng-sre): unresolved: tokenization edge-case logged, but not a hard blocker. Recommend monitor first 30m post-ramp. +1 for go with watch.
maria (release-lead): GO. Starting slow ramp at 00:00 UTC per runbook. Post-launch on-call roster: maria, chris, alex, taylor, sam.
ci-bot: [DEPLOY] Rollout started at 2026-03-22T00:00Z. Rolling out in 3 waves, 10m between waves. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/change-windows/release-v3.4.2
maria (release-lead): thanks all — stay in-thread for 60m after full ramp. react here with :eyes: when you’re watching. :rocket:
